 Persebaya vs Java United Results: Miguel Pereira's Early Goal Cancelled Out by Ridho Syuhada, 1-1 at Half-Time
 Persebaya Surabaya and Java United FC are locked in a tight contest during the 10th week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League, ending the first half at 1-1.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Niken Pramudya 
 November 21, 2026 at 6:29 PM WITA ·
 5 min read
 Miguel Pereira celebrates after scoring the opening goal for Persebaya Surabaya against Java United during the 2026/2027 BRI Super League match at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium, Saturday (11/21/2026). Photo: Persebaya Media. 
 SURABAYA, Aktualita.co -  The match result of Persebaya Surabaya against Java United FC, the club previously known as Malut United, presented a tight competition in the 10th week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. Both teams were tied 1-1 throughout the first half at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium, Surabaya, Saturday (11/21/2026). 
 Persebaya actually started the match promisingly. The team nicknamed Bajul Ijo took an immediate lead through a Miguel Pereira goal just three minutes into the match.

 However, that lead could not be maintained until the break. Java United managed to equalize through Ridho Syuhada in the 36th minute after capitalizing on a pass from Ciro Alves. 
 Two goals in the first half made for an open game. Persebaya tried to maximize their home-field advantage, while Java United showed resilience after falling behind early. 
 Miguel Pereira Gives Persebaya an Early Lead 
 Persebaya immediately took the initiative to attack from the opening whistle. Bernardo Tavares' squad tried to pressure the Java United defense through wing movements and passing combinations around the penalty box. 
 The strategy paid off in the third minute. 
 Starting from an attack built by Persebaya, Arief Catur Pamungkas sent a pass into the opponent's defensive area. Miguel Pereira, who was in an advantageous position, managed to strike the ball and beat Java United goalkeeper Jorge Meurer Bartholdy. 
 The goal gave Persebaya a 1-0 lead and provided a confidence boost to the home players. 
 After taking the lead, Persebaya did not immediately ease off the pressure. Francisco Rivera and Jefferson were involved several times in attempts to break down the visitors' defense. 
 In the 24th minute, Rivera created an opportunity through his movement in the Java United defensive area. However, the ball was still anticipated by the opposing players. 
 The next opportunity came around the 30th minute when Rivera sent a pass to Jefferson. Unfortunately, Jefferson's final touch did not find the target. 
 Ridho Syuhada Equalizes for Java United 
 Java United, trailing by one goal, slowly found their rhythm. 
 Fabio Lefundes' team tried to build attacks through the wings, relying on the movement of Ciro Alves and support from other players. 
 Ciro had an opportunity through a free kick in the 17th minute, but the ball sailed over the Persebaya crossbar. 
 Entering the 34th minute, Java United began to apply more serious pressure. Persebaya was still able to thwart the threat through the actions of defender Walber Motta. 
 Two minutes later, the Persebaya defense finally conceded. 
 Ciro Alves was again instrumental in creating the opportunity for Java United. After an initial attempt from a set-piece situation was cleared, Ciro controlled the ball and sent a pass in front of the goal. 
 Ridho Syuhada managed to meet the delivery to score the equalizer in the 36th minute. 
 The score changed to 1-1. Until the referee ended the first half, neither team was able to add another goal. 
 Persebaya Attempts to End Unsatisfactory Trend 
 The match against Java United was an important game for Persebaya, who are trying to improve their performance in the domestic competition. 
 Before this match, Persebaya had experienced a number of results that were not up to expectations, including a 0-1 defeat to Persija Jakarta on November 7, 2026. 
 The result caused Bernardo Tavares' team to come under scrutiny from their supporters. 
 Despite facing pressure, Tavares emphasized that the players had a longer preparation time to face Java United after the competition break. 
 Persebaya midfielder, Toni Firmansyah, also expressed the team's determination to achieve maximum results at home. 
 "It's an important match for us, and hopefully we give our best performance and get three points at home," said Toni Firmansyah in a statement published on the official I.League website ahead of the match. 
 Miguel Pereira's quick goal showed Persebaya's positive response at the start of the match. However, Java United's success in equalizing showed that there is still work to be done for the host's defensive line. 
 Java United Arrives with Positive Momentum 
 Java United is not an easy opponent for Persebaya. 
 Before the match took place, the team nicknamed Laskar Kepodang Emas recorded six consecutive matches without defeat in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. 
 That record consists of four wins and two draws. 
 One of the important results achieved by Java United was a 2-1 victory over Persib Bandung on November 8, 2026. 
 Java United coach, Fabio Lefundes, previously stated that his team did not want to think too much about the pressure Persebaya is facing. 
 "We are focused on ensuring maximum performance in the match and achieving victory," said Fabio Lefundes in a press conference ahead of the match, Friday (11/20/2026). 
 Java United's resistance in the first half was an indication that the visitors came prepared to compete, not just to defend. 
 Head-to-Head Record of Persebaya and Malut United 
 The meeting between the two teams has an interesting history, even though Malut United now uses the identity of Java United FC. 
 In their previous meeting on April 23, 2026, Persebaya managed to secure a 2-0 victory when visiting their opponent's headquarters. 
 Previously, Persebaya also defeated Malut United with a score of 2-1 at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium on January 10, 2026. Both of Persebaya's goals at that time were scored by Paulo Gali Freitas. 
 However, Malut United once recorded a 2-0 victory at Persebaya's home on January 17, 2025. 
 Meanwhile, the meeting between the two teams on August 16, 2024, ended in a goalless draw. 
 The history shows that Persebaya and the club now named Java United have beaten each other several times. 
 Persebaya vs Java United Result Still Awaiting Final Confirmation 
 As this report was compiled, the confirmed score is 1-1 in the first half, through goals from Miguel Pereira for Persebaya and Ridho Syuhada for Java United. 
 This match is an important part of the competition between the two teams in the middle of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League standings. 
 Persebaya needs additional points to improve their position and restore confidence, while Java United is trying to maintain their positive momentum. 
 The final result of the match and the changes in the positions of both teams in the standings still require confirmation through the official report from the competition organizers.
